fixed.base: NFIShortATRGated: original long exits, short 2x1hATR/2R and fee-aware 1% planned risk capped by original initial margin; BTC4h bear gate covers all shorts

variants.control: same engine/data pipeline, no RS filters
variants.both15: long positive / short negative 15m log relative return
variants.both60: long positive / short negative 1h log relative return
variants.both240: long positive / short negative 4h log relative return
variants.beta60: 1h residual with 7-day beta fit ending before measured hour
variants.momentum60: 1h relative sign plus same-direction absolute coin return

benchmark: BTC exempt from self-relative filtering in every case
availability: closed synchronous 5m bars; gaps invalidate lookbacks; beta no fitting within score horizon
interpretation: no position multipliers or new entry triggers
each horizon is a rolling return updated each 5m, not one native HTF bar
filters select among NFI entries; no cross-sectional top-k ordering claim
